name: Chichester April 2025
information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

## Important Note for MBLD:
There is a 20 competitor limit for MBLD. Please read the [MBLD](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChichesterApril2025#49849-mbld) tab for more details.
